# The Accursed Kings: The Law of Men (Vol. 4)

Experience the epic sweep of political intrigue, royal drama, and brutal history with *The Accursed Kings: The Law of Men*. From the acclaimed brand Litera, this fourth volume continues the gripping saga of dynastic struggle, making it an essential read for fans of deep historical fantasy.

## Dive into a World of Royal Intrigue

When Ludovic X dies under suspicious circumstances, poisoned by Mahaut Drsquo; Artois is set to claim the throne. However, Artois' path to power is blocked by the existence of another claimant: the unborn child of Queen Cleacute; Mence.

The political landscape is a powder keg. Facing a nation consumed by revolt, rebellious nobles, and a conclave of cardinals vying for papal selection, King Philip must employ every resource at his disposal to save France from anarchy. But how far will he go to claim the crown? Will he be willing to shed the morals expected of a king?

*The Law of Men* plunges readers into the heart of high stakes history, where ambition and survival collide in dazzling detail.

### Why Readers Are Captivated by This Saga

The depth and scope of this series draw powerful comparisons to the greatest epics of literature. The praise speaks volumes about its quality:

> *"Wild, sensual, full of life, richly documented... among the best historical novels."* â The Times Literary Supplement

And for fans of grand family sagas, the comparison is even stronger:

> *"The Accursed Kings of all time: kings of iron and queens of suffering, civil wars, lies and sensuality, deceivers, family rivalries, the curse of the Knights Templar, babies switched at birth, she-wolves, the fall of a great dynastyâand all this (or most of it) is drawn directly from the pages of history. And, believe me, the Stark and Lannister families are no more interesting than the Capetians and Plantagenets. Whether you are passionate about history or fantasy literature, you will not be able to leave Druon's novelsâit is 'A Song of Ice and Fire in its original form.'"* â George R.R. Martin

This novel expertly weaves real historical turmoil with thrilling fictional character arcs, making it an unmissable journey through the heart of European royalty.
